_about: Data for the combined station js/cook/stations/mishkaki-grill.js. `station` is its name and goal line (merged into data.stations). `words` are the skewer kinds the order names (English placeholders until the family gives the Kutchi; ghos = meat is the draft word ph-meat). `mechanic.skewer` is shared by the thread and grill mechanics: which piece is meat or veg (`classes`), which word names which kind of skewer (`kinds`), and how each piece is drawn on a skewer (`art`, placeholder). `mechanic.levels` say which level each zone's mechanic runs at (the grill's own levels in data/cook.json add spots and speed); the order's shape per level (1 skewer; 2; 3-4 with mixed) is the mishkaki recipe's `skewers` slot.

station.name: Mishkaki grill
station.goal: Thread what they asked for. Grill each one: turn it on the green twice, then lift it onto the plate.

ph-mixed._note: a skewer of meat and vegetables, threaded in the order said
